checks: Read work_summary, the report entry (value/assumptions/uncertainty), out/q28r2/fit_base.txt and analysis_base.txt. The numbers quoted in the report match the output files line by line: joint chi2 24.9 (17.1+7.8); one-state 51.6/40.0; ln BF 29.5; profile chi2(Tk_E) minimum at 79-133 K with <79 K excluded; n_E 3.6-4.75; P(cold) 0.68 N / 0.49 S; branch predictions for HCN 3-2/1-0, 4-3, 4-3/3-2 and H13CN/HCN. Agree.

Independently recomputed the column-to-surface-density conversion: 2.8 m_H/(1 pc)^2 = 2.242e-20 Msun/pc2 per cm-2 H2, equal to the 2.244e-20 used. N_E=1e14 HCO+ at X=1e-8 gives 224 Msun/pc2, above the 77 cap, so the capped fits must lower N_E to ~3e13; the cap is a real constraint. Agree with the dust-cap logic. The cap rests on the assumed dust opacity, Td and gas-to-dust ratio.

Round-1 fixes: all six were addressed (joint N+S fit with beam overlap and a shared E phase; two-sided 0.24 and 1.29 arcsec T_b; finer extended grid; profile likelihoods; bootstrap and LOO; dust cap). The overlap term is <5% of the 10 arcsec flux and is handled with a 30% error, which is reasonable.

Significance calibration is acceptable. The report gives confidence low, calls Tk_C undecided (the N cold preference P=0.68 is driven by the 2.2 arcsec data and falls to the prior level without them), says the N/S A_C contrast has overlapping 1-sigma ranges, and says v2=1 does not discriminate Tk_C. No overclaim found.

Remaining weaknesses, not blocking because this is the last round and they are stated or can be stated as caveats: A_E sits at the grid edge (0.5 dex), so the E profile likelihoods are conditional on A_E<=3; the compact size is pinned at the 0.5 arcsec grid value; peak T_b is compared with a 150 km/s model line while the 0.24 arcsec line is narrower; E is a uniform slab; only 24 bootstrap sims; ln BF values depend on priors and the Occam volume; Tk_E of 80-130 K at n~1e4 conflicts with dust Td<~30-50 K unless X(HCO+)>=5e-9 to 1e-8 (the report states this tension and gives both readings). The 77 Msun/pc2 cap may be tight compared with CO-based Sigma at 100 pc scales (Brunetti+2021: 8-5500 Msun/pc2), but it is a 10 arcsec average and was not checked here.
notes_for_questioner: (1) The decisive observable for Tk_C is HCN 4-3/3-2 and the 4-3 peak T_b at <=0.5 arcsec (0.34 vs 0.60). The Band 7 archive here is 4 arcsec, so this needs other ALMA projects or restored visibilities: is a request worth it? (2) An independent thermometer for the 80-130 K extended gas (CO 3-2/1-0 from Michiyama+2018, H2CO or CH3OH ladders) would test the ridge that the HCN+HCO+ ladders cannot check, and would help with the X(HCO+)/dust tension. (3) Publish with the caveats above: the supported results are the rejection of a single-state model (p<0.04) and of Tk_E<~70 K for the 10 arcsec gas, with the N excess carried by the compact phase (A_C ~3 vs ~1, not yet significant). Tk_C is not determined.
